identification: Cartel (Korea) wooden take-down recurve bows. Photos show THREE laminated wood risers (two in a brown padded Cartel case, one laid out) with knob limb bolts, black limb pockets, one pair of white glass-faced limbs with blue Cartel limb decal, a bar sight, a plunger/arrow rest, spare limb bolts, string, plus a black Cartel soft case and red Cartel bow sleeve. Entry-level club/training bows. Catalogue: estimate A$20-40; current bid A$65 at 10 Nov. Most likely Cartel Sirius (or Sirius Edge / Sirius Plus) wood-laminated take-down beginner recurves: the striped laminated riser shape matches the sold Cartel Sirius on eBay, and Cartel's only wooden take-down line is the Sirius family (Hoddywell: 'wood laminated riser with a pair of' limbs). Draw weight and length not readable (Sirius limbs come in 54-70 in, typically 18-38 lb). Only one pair of limbs is visible for three risers, so the lot may be two complete bows plus a spare riser, or limbs may be in the case.
